<title level="1" right="Class Feature 19">[Supreme Incarnation](/Classes.aspx?ID=64)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [War of Immortals](/Sources.aspx?ID=232) pg. 10

**Class** Animist
</column>

---

You become a nexus between the mortal and spiritual realms through which your apparition can embody its full might. You gain a 10th-rank apparition spell slot. In addition to heightened versions of your apparition spells, you can use this slot to cast [_avatar_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1446). When you cast _avatar_ in this way, you do not become an avatar of a deity; rather, your primary attuned apparition incarnates itself using your body, transforming you into the avatar described in your primary attuned apparition's entry.
name: Supreme Incarnation
